label: Market Close
headline: S&P -1.92%, Nasdaq 100 -2.49%, VIX 22.91, Brent $91.84 -4.2%, Red Cat -25% after hours
stance: Chip stocks pulled the S&P down 1.92%, a day before Nvidia reports. Bonds rallied and oil fell, so the damage stayed in equities.

scorecard.call: Morning: Tuesday's chip results decide this week's equity direction.
scorecard.actual: S&P closed -1.92% Monday, a day early. The 11:33 loss of 1.02% nearly doubled into the close.

scorecard.call: Morning: oil fell overnight despite two more tanker hits in Hormuz.
scorecard.actual: Brent closed $91.84, -4.2%. Iran reported a fourth tanker hit at 5:32pm; crude still fell.

scorecard.call: Midday: rates held flat and oil fell, so this is an equity selloff.
scorecard.actual: Right. 10y closed 5.12%, -3bp; 2y -5bp. Bonds rallied while stocks fell.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Cleveland Fed's Hammack: economy can handle more restriction, inflation going the wrong way (2:28pm).
Iran says a fourth tanker hit in 24 hours; UKMTO reports a Hormuz attack near Oman (5:32pm).
Canada October CPI 3.1% vs 3.2% expected (4:19pm wrap).

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Commerce rule requires licences for AI chip exports to data centers in five Asian and Latin American countries (2:30pm). Chip stocks led the drop.
VIX3M 23.02 with VIX 22.91: the curve is flat, one step from inversion.
S&P futures little changed after the close (6:14pm).

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HYG/LQD ratio rose on the day. High yield held up while stocks fell 2%.

items.head: Red Cat -25.5% after hours (6:41pm)
items.body: Q3 missed on revenue and EPS; revenue guidance withdrawn (4:21pm).

items.head: Intel -4.7% after hours (6:41pm)
items.body: Closed -7.0% on a shareholder suit over PC disclosures. Extended losses after Nvidia cut its stake (5:48pm).

items.head: SharonAI -4.1% after hours (6:37pm)
items.body: Q3 missed on revenue and EPS (4:39pm). Stock closed -10.8%.

watch.head: Retail sales, Nov 17, 8:30
watch.body: Tier-1 consumer data. Import prices also at 8:30; industrial production at 9:15.

watch.head: Nvidia results, Nov 17, after the close
watch.body: Results ~4:20pm ET. Stock closed -4.1% Monday ahead of the report.

watch.head: Home Depot reports Nov 17
watch.body: Options price a large post-report move (3:32pm).
